data.one_liner: AES with PKCS7 padding encryption wrapper with simple encrypt and decrypt functions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-level API wrapper around the encrypt package for AES encryption and decryption using simple function calls. Allows text to be encrypted and decrypted using a provided key.
use_when: You need a simple high-level API for AES text encryption and decryption in Flutter
You want a quick way to handle basic encryption tasks without complex configuration
avoid_when: You need maximum security requiring randomized IV handling
You require advanced cryptographic features beyond basic AES with PKCS7 padding
strengths: Provides straightforward string-based encryption and decryption
weaknesses: Limited feature set as a basic wrapper
Lacks randomized IV support for higher security out of the box
